decisions.reason: False positive: the cited Hoeffding theorem Statement explicitly says “With the components of [[def-product-hoeffding-anova-components]]”. That Definition is exactly f_u=sum_{v subset u}(-1)^(|u|-|v|)P_v f; the formula is therefore part of the imported interface, not an additional premise. Tensor integration gives support projection, finite Mobius cancellation isolates support u, and bounded finite sums of contractions pass the complete-family Parseval limit. CC supplies both real L2 completeness and Parseval; normalization is restricted to V>0.

The L2 assumption does not imply finite second moments of Z: with d=1, P(X=k) proportional to k^-4 and f(k)=k, E[X^2] is finite but E[X^4] is infinite. N=X^2-UV therefore has infinite second moment (restrict UV to a bounded positive-probability event). Calling its sample covariance unbiased and its plug-in matrix an MCSE without qualification is invalid. Retained all L2 ratio inputs and outputs, explicitly defined the empirical n-1 covariance, and qualified the formal matrix: the existing separate CLT supplies the MCSE interpretation under AC, L4 and V>0. Its step 1.1 verifies finite row second moments, and step 3.2 proves plug-in convergence; no additional choice use is introduced.

Confirmed nonfatal omitted boundary qualification in Verification 2.1: F6 already requires the selected normalization variance positive, but the subsequent division did not repeat that condition. For constant f and tau^2=0 the ratio is 0/0. Step 2.1 now explicitly permits the noisy ratio only when V_f+tau^2>0 and states it is undefined when both vanish. Independence kills all noise/input and distinct-noise cross covariances; the unchanged unnormalized identities Var(Y)=V_f+tau^2, first numerator V_{i}(f), and total numerator sum_{u containing i} V_u(f)+tau^2 hold also in the zero case. Conditional-mean indices continue to require V_f>0. No Statement or Definition changed, so this proof-only repair does not propagate.

Confirmed nonfatal notation error in F1: D denotes one row, while the algorithm returns barN/barD iff the sample mean barD>0. The proof already uses the correct event K>0 with barD=K/4 for two rows. Corrected F1 only. For Bernoulli(1/2), E N_r=E D_r=1/4, K is Binomial(2,1/2) independent of numerator draws, and the conditional ratio mean is (2/3)*1+(1/3)*(1/2)=5/6 while S_1=1. The algorithm repair preserves this row law and return event; bounded f also meets the stronger moment condition if an MCSE interpretation is needed. No Statement or Definition changed.
